title: Relative tilting, interlacing categories and rational Dyck posets
summary: We construct an explicit tilting equivalence between the incidence algebra of every rational Dyck staircase and a canonical idempotent corner of a higher Auslander algebra of type~$A$. In the coprime case, this corner identifies with the algebra $B_0$ introduced by Xing. The resulting Dyck-corner equivalence supplies the missing link in the previously known chain of equivalences and thereby proves the Chapoton-Ladkani-Rognerud conjecture for coprime positive integers. The Dyck-corner equivalence itself requires no coprimality hypothesis and is compatible with replicated algebras. Our main…
